_comment: PROVEN-READ subset of loose-realism-v2.json: only edits to fields an instruction in eFootball.exe reads.

edits.why: TOUCH ERROR: worse first touches for everyone (scales Ball Control into the trap error angle)

Ball-speed (kph) threshold at which a team-mate's ground pass is handled as a reflex 'reaction trap' rather than a clean trap, for a low-attribute player (paraMin). Normal grounders arrive at 32-36 kph (grounderpass.rece
High-attribute end of the same threshold (-15%). Top players still handle harder passes than weak ones, but the whole curve shifts down so more driven passes get the awkward handling.
Reaction time (s) for a low-attribute player on a fast team-mate ground pass. +33% = slower settle, ball bobbles/sits off the foot for an extra 3 frames. Longer time = worse under any reading.
High-attribute end of the reaction time (+30%), preserving the min/max ordering (0.20 > 0.13).

Same threshold for a BOUNCING ball (deflections, clearances, blocked shots) reaching a low-attribute player; -16% means more second balls are met with a reflex touch instead of a clean gather — directly 'loose balls happ
High-attribute end of the bouncing-ball threshold (-15%), keeps the min/max gap.

ballForceDirect (use=true) places the ball at a fixed offset ahead of the player after a trap: Idle 0.5 / Run 1.5 / Dash 2.0 (blendStartSpeed.speed_0/15/28 = 0.5/1.75/2.0 confirms these are distances growing with speed).
Same as above for sprint traps (+20%). Sprint first touches are where real players lose the ball most; this makes that the case here too.

After an unintended body collision, foot/leg/thigh cannot re-hit the ball for N frames (noHit.foot/reg/thigh all true). 10 -> 14 frames (+40%, ~67 ms more at 60 fps) keeps ricochets and blocked passes loose for longer be

At max assist (index 3 = PA3) a long-held ground pass currently takes 0% of the stick direction. 0.2 blends a fifth of the aim into the target, so imprecise aiming produces under/over-hit or misdirected passes. Same dire
Short-press (weak gauge) ground passes at PA3 gain a small stick component; kept half the Strong value because short passes should stay mostly assisted (PA2 uses 0.3 vs 0.8).

Hypothesis: pass length (m) above which manual blending is applied (grounder 20, fly 30 fit metre ranges like manual.distForGageMin/Max 4..40). Lowering it subjects more medium-range passes to the stick blend.
Lofted equivalent of the grounder edit: PA3 strong-gauge lofted passes get 20% stick influence (PA1/PA2 already use 0.5).
Full-gauge lofted passes at PA3 also receive the stick blend (PA1/PA2 = 0.6). Leaves Weak.3 at 0 so short chips stay assisted.
Same hypothesis as the grounder threshold: lofted passes above ~22 m (instead of 30) become subject to the manual blend.

Only lever that scales pass quality by the passer's attribute for BOTH teams: a low-attribute passer's ground pass is hit at 78% speed instead of 90% (99-rated stays 1.0). Slower balls from weak passers fall short and ar

Weak lofted passers already loft max-distance balls higher than strong ones (6.3 vs 4.8). +19% adds hang time so their long balls are easier to contest/intercept and harder to bring down. Stays below heightForDistMax_hig
BALLOON FIX: launch elevation back to stock

Air-resistance multiplier (1.0 = Konami default). +12% bleeds more speed in flight, so shots from outside the box arrive weaker and dip more; close-range shots are barely affected because flight time is short — a natural
BALLOON FIX: back to stock — 0.06 amplified backspin lift enough to fight gravity
stronger knuckle wobble (knuckle branch only — cannot affect normal-spin Magnus)
v2: restore zonal cover (v1 over-loosened to 0.35)

Prediction horizon (frames, 60 fps => 2.0 s) the positioning AI uses to anticipate where the play will be when choosing base positions (marginPredictionFrameBase is 0, so this is the whole horizon). Cutting to 1.5 s make

Percent chance/weight that a defender keeps his current match-up (man-marking assignment) instead of handing off to a teammate and snapping back to zonal shape. Raising by 10 points makes defenders follow runners further
Same as matchUpContinueRate but for FW/MF match-ups; keep the +10 offset Konami uses between the two so the relative behaviour of front and back units is preserved.
v2: livelier midfield band
